take: Utah announced it has placed Dylan Guenther and Nate Schmidt on injured reserve, activated Kailer Yamamoto from injured reserve and recalled Daniil But from Tucson. Yamamoto's return helps: Utah controls 68% of the 5-on-5 chances with him on the ice, and he is already up to 18:13 a night in Guenther's absence. But has taken Guenther's spot beside Schmaltz and Keller, and Dmitri Simashev has stepped in beside Peeke for Schmidt, who has been a strong 5-on-5 presence (62% of the chances).
